_comment: Per-clip locomotion metadata. blend_in_seconds = inertialization decay duration when this clip becomes loco_current. translation_source: 'velocity' (engine drives via velocity_xz * dt, requires walk/jog/sprint_speed tuning to match clip cadence), 'root_motion' (clip drives world translation via consumedHipDelta), 'in_place' (no extraction; the actor stays put). playback_rate scales BOTH foot cadence AND root translation (no skating). For directional gait clips that travel, prefer root_motion so world speed always matches authored foot cadence -- velocity needs hand-tuning per clip pair to avoid skating.

clips._section_comment: PC HUMANOID locomotion -- unarmed + sword_and_shield. AnimSet (config/anim/*.json) resolves intent -> clip; this file tunes per-clip blend + translation source. All gait clips are root_motion: each Mixamo source ships its own authored cadence and we don't want to fight it with tuned velocity numbers.

PC one-shots with authored hip travel. Classification is authoritative -- the 1.5m hip-path heuristic was removed, so every clip whose visible motion translates the body must declare root_motion or it stays in_place by default (mesh moves, body doesn't, camera doesn't follow).

Wolf clips (Quaternius rig). In-place authoring: feet-cycling-while-body-stationary, world translation comes from gameplay velocity. walk uses velocity so tun.walk_speed * dt drives motion; attack/eating/idle stay in_place because the clip's own micro-motion is purely visual (a bite that lunges forward should NOT slide the body).

Soul larva (Scary Zombie Pack, baked against humanoid rig). zombie_walk/run/crawl declared root_motion: Mixamo zombie clips have authored hip-XZ travel at the animator's chosen shamble cadence, NOT at engine walk_speed -- velocity-driven translation at tun.walk_speed=1.6 produced visible skating because feet were authored ~0.6 m/s. Root motion lets the clip's authored cadence drive world translation, foot rate matches step rate by construction.
